hp.imposing: Imposing; their form is pristine, radiating an aura of untouched power.
hp.weathered: Weathered; minor injuries or disruptions mark their form, but their stance remains firm.
hp.battered: Battered; visible wounds or flickering essence betray the toll of battle, slowing them down.
hp.broken: Broken; they stagger with ragged desperation, their existence hanging by a thread.
hp.fallen: Fallen; the vessel has succumbed, collapsing into stillness or dissipation.

stress.unshakeable: Unshakeable; their mind is a fortress, operating with absolute, terrifying clarity.
stress.guarded: Guarded; a subtle tension tightens their movements, the weight of the moment setting in.
stress.rattled: Rattled; hesitation fractures their focus, erratic energy revealing their inner turmoil.
stress.overwhelmed: Overwhelmed; panic or instability has taken hold, leaving them erratic and unpredictable.
stress.shattered: Shattered; their mental defenses have crumbled, leaving them utterly exposed and vulnerable to any threat.

INTERFACE.title: Interface Settings
INTERFACE.intro: World-wide interface changes made by this module, collected here. Each switch applies immediately — there is nothing to save.
INTERFACE.menuHint: Turns off everything this module changes in the system's own sidebar menu: the purple skull tab icon, the search bar, the alphabetical section ordering, the collapsible sections and the two-column button grid. The module's own Quick Actions section stays in the menu either way — only its layout falls back to the system default.
INTERFACE.tooltipHint: Shows a stat summary tooltip when hovering over character tokens on the canvas. Each player picks its size with Token Tooltip Size in the module settings list.
INTERFACE.hopeHint: Draws a row of Hope diamonds above character tokens, following each token's own Display Bars setting. Turn this off when another module already renders Hope on tokens.

settings.heading: Custom Tables
settings.hint: Drag roll tables here from the Rollable Tables directory or from a compendium. They will be listed by QuickActions.CustomTables().
settings.missing: Not found — the table was deleted or its compendium is unavailable
settings.noteAccess: Players need to see the table. A roll table created in the sidebar starts with no player access at all, so it works for you and fails for them. Set its ownership to Observer — and do the same for the compendium holding the items it hands out, which is one setting for the whole pack.
settings.noteItems: Items only. Results are handed to the sheet when they point at an Item. A text entry, or a link to an actor or journal, is shown in the chat card but nothing is added.
settings.noteIndependent: Every draw is independent. A table set to draw without replacement still repeats, because the roller never writes back to your table.

REST.title: Choose Rest Type
REST.question: What type of rest would you like to take?

efficient.name: Efficient
efficient.description: During Short Rest, one selected action can be upgraded to Long Rest quality.

forager.name: Forager
forager.description: Grants a bonus Forage action that does not count towards the move limit.

premiumBedroll.name: Premium Bedroll
premiumBedroll.description: During downtime, you automatically clear 1 Stress.

eloquent.name: Eloquent
eloquent.description: Allows granting a bonus move to another party member.

soothingSpeech.name: Soothing Speech
soothingSpeech.description: When using Tend to Wounds on another character during Short Rest, clear an additional HP on the target. You also clear 2 HP on yourself.

armorer.name: Armorer
armorer.description: When you choose Repair Armor as a downtime move, all allies also clear an Armor Slot.

beastbound.name: Beastbound
beastbound.description: If you choose a downtime move that clears your Stress, your companion clears an equal amount.

recovery.name: Recovery
recovery.description: During a short rest, you can choose a long rest downtime move instead. You can spend 1 Hope to let an ally do the same.

favor.name: Favor
favor.description: Adds the "Show Tribute" downtime move: describe how you honour your patron and gain Favor equal to your Spellcast trait. Spends one move; the Favor itself is applied by the player.

changeShape.name: Change Shape
changeShape.description: Shapeshifter. Adds the "Change Shape" downtime move: swap your current ancestry for another and describe how your appearance changes. Spends one move; the swap itself is applied by the player.

onlySkinDeep.name: Only Skin Deep
onlySkinDeep.description: Shapeshifter. Adds the "Only Skin Deep" downtime move: choose a different feature from your current ancestry. Spends one move; the swap itself is applied by the player.

oasis.name: Oasis
oasis.description: Duneborne. During a short rest, reroll one die used for a downtime move and keep the higher result. Mark the move with the water badge, or hand the reroll to an ally.

timekeepersPendant.name: Timekeeper's Pendant
timekeepersPendant.description: Grants one additional downtime move each rest.

pipeweed.name: Pipeweed
pipeweed.description: Adds the free "Smoke Pipeweed" move during a short rest. Smoking one clears an additional Stress for every PC who chose Clear Stress, and spends one Pipeweed.

config.title: Downtime Config
config.coreInfo: These are the default core features used during downtime. You can replace the linked item if needed — the mechanical effect stays the same, and a character has the feature when they own a copy of the new item or an item with the same name.
config.craftInfo: If an actor owns a copy of the recipe item, or an item with the same name, the crafted item will be added to their sheet when the downtime move is executed.
config.customInfo: Add custom move names that will appear as selectable actions during downtime. These are freeform labels — no item link required. Use the rest type selector to restrict when each move is available.
config.itemMovesInfo: Drag items here to create moves linked to specific items. The move will only appear for actors who own a copy of the item, or an item with the same name. Use the rest type selector to restrict when each move is available.
config.usersInfo: Switch off any user who should never take part in downtime. A disabled user is hidden from the Downtime window even while connected, and is skipped when the downtime effects are applied.

With Core Set + Hope & Fear the two books share one rarity scale, so a 1d12 sees 24 common items instead of 12 — a second d12 decides which book the entry comes from (1–6 Core Set, 7–12 Hope & Fear).
